Nice to meet you. I always enjoy your 🌈🕒 fan art. I love all the beautiful patterns, colors, and world view. ......

I would like to request an original character to be my alter ego (avatar) if you don't mind.
For more details, please see the reference material.

She is androgynous.
(She is androgynous)
Dark blue hair
Yellow eyes

You may draw the costume as shown in the reference material, or you may draw your original costume as you like.
Composition and situations are also up to you.

I am not a VTuber, but I am active in singing in a small community and would like to use it in pfp and delivery thumbnails if possible.

I would be happy to see my character in your drawing style: ......!
Best regards.

Hi, I'm a newbie and I'm looking forward to reading your illustrations! I really love your illustrations!

I would like to ask you to draw my original character.

They are demon hunters. The man is a wolf demon and the woman is his master. They work as partners and trust each other very much.
The man is cynical and laughs a lot. The girl is cool and quiet.

I really like the illustration of Shu I drew here! https://twitter.com/555goo1/status/1642533335342944258

I would like to request a similar mood and background theme! Maybe somewhere indoors by a window would be nice!

Pose and composition is up to you. Feel free to adjust the clothing!

Thank you in advance for your consideration.

hello! Your drawings are so beautiful! I would like to request an illustration from you of my original character, if possible!

ARIS can be drawn in either a masculine or feminine appearance! ARIS is flirtatious and has an irritating personality, but is also surprisingly mature. His motifs are roses, wine, smoke, and ravens. He wears red and black clothes and has light blonde hair! Feel free to design his clothes and draw what you like!
